description:
Use this when the user asks for the guna milan / kundli matching score (out of 36), or whether either person is Manglik.
The classical Aṣṭakūṭa match for a pair (all eight kūṭas, with the Bhakoot and Nāḍī doṣas) and Manglik for both charts reckoned from the lagna, the Moon and Venus, with mutual cancellation. The same engine as /v1/compatibility, without the full reading: the score is one input, and /v1/compatibility reads each chart's marital promise, timing and doṣas on top of it. Deterministic, no language model.
Cost: 2 credits per call (only successful calls are charged; a sandbox key is free and returns a fixed sample).
Deterministic: the same input always gives the same answer.
Example arguments: {"a":{"date":"1990-05-12","time":"14:35","timezone":"Asia/Kolkata","latitude":28.6139,"longitude":77.209,"name":"A"},"b":{"date":"1991-11-03","time":"06:10","timezone":"Asia/Kolkata","latitude":19.076,"longitude":72.8777,"name":"B"}}

time.description: 24-hour HH:MM or HH:MM:SS, local to `timezone`. Omit if unknown: house-dependent detail is then reduced.

timezone.description: IANA timezone of the birthplace, e.g. Asia/Kolkata.

a.description: First partner: birth data plus optional name and gender.

name: get_guna_milan

requestId.description: Quote this in any support request.

sandbox.description: Present and true only on sandbox-key responses: a fixed sample, not computed from your request.

cancelled.description: True when the doṣa is neutralised across the pair (both Manglik, or the one present is self-mitigated).

points.description: The graded Kuja doṣa comparison (a points table reckoned from the lagna): a weighing of how evenly the two charts carry the doṣa — never a cancellation. variation = |A − B| ÷ the smaller total (null when one chart carries none and the other some); balanced = variation ≤ 0.25. Symmetric: no gendered threshold.

pointsTotals.description: Each chart's Kuja points total (lagna reckoning).

roles.description: Which partner was read as the groom (Varṇa is counted from the groom).

Manglik.description: Manglik (Kuja doṣa) for one chart, reckoned from the lagna, the Moon and Venus. A reckoning with house null was not computed — never read it as clean. Classical exceptions are applied and named: whole-chart ones in cancelledBy (Mars in Leo or Aquarius; in its own sign or exalted, or exalted in the marriage sub-chart; conjunct Jupiter or the Moon; Jupiter or Venus in the ascendant), per-house ones on the reckoning as exemptBy.

cancelledBy.description: Classical exceptions (parihāra) that cancel the doṣa for this chart, each with the texts that state it. When any applies, present is false — the reckonings still show where Mars stands.

exemptBy.description: Set when Mars stands in a doṣa house but its sign exempts it there (2nd Gemini/Virgo, 4th Aries/Scorpio, 7th Capricorn/Cancer, 8th Sagittarius/Pisces, 12th Taurus/Libra) — the stated reason, with its sources.

remaining_credits.description: Your one-time free credits left plus the paid balance, after this call.
